summary: MCP-only Google Docs task: apply Finance's Q3 supplier surcharge to the current AccessoryHub wholesale price list while preserving exempt products, historical reference rows, document structure, and the distractor document.
check_strategy: Verifier reads the final Google Docs mock state, evaluates atom-level document predicates, then folds them into stable capability checks by pure AND aggregation. Binary reward requires all capability checks to pass.

checks.description: The mock state is readable and the target price-list document exists exactly once.
All imported current-catalogue SKUs have the 12% surcharge applied and rounded to the nearest $0.05.
Domestic, discontinued, and re-sourced SKUs keep their original current-catalogue prices.
Each SKU remains represented exactly once as a product price line in the current-catalogue region.
The Previous Quarter reference section keeps every SKU row at its original Q2 price.
The title, intro, Products heading, Notes heading, and footer remain present.
The supplier-contact distractor document remains unchanged.
The final workspace still contains the expected number of non-trashed documents.
At least one Workspace/MCP document update tool call was used.

notes: The memo is required task input: it states the finance rule, exceptions, and rounding convention needed to perform the document edit. The discriminating failure mode is over-broad document replacement: correct current-catalogue prices are not enough if the Q2 reference section or unrelated supplier-contact document is also modified.
